attendance/check-ins.lifecycle.spec.ts::: Posts checkIns/recordCheckIn with clientType 'member' and no clientId
Asserts the zod superRefine rejects it with 400 ('clientId is required for member check-ins')
Resolves the caller's own members.userId as the clientId (a real member)
Records a first member drop-in check-in (succeeds, returns id) and registers deleteCheckIn teardown
Asserts a second member drop-in for the same client within 30 min is rejected with 409 (ALREADY_CHECKED_IN)
Deletes the created check-in on teardown
